# A-5 · Remediation Actions

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | A Assess (system level) |
| Phases | PH-EMD (primary) |
| Depends on | A-4 |
| Inputs | ART-SAR, ART-SSP, ART-SAP, ART-RA |
| Outputs | ART-SAR (updates), ART-SSP (updates) |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PER-PM, PER-CCP, PER-SCA, PER-DEV · A: PER-PM · C: PER-AODR, PER-CISO, PER-PRIV, PER-RE, PER-IO, PER-ISSE, PER-ISSM · I: — |
| Persona cards | [PER-PM](../../personas/PER-PM.md), [PER-CCP](../../personas/PER-CCP.md), [PER-SCA](../../personas/PER-SCA.md), [PER-DEV](../../personas/PER-DEV.md), [PER-AODR](../../personas/PER-AODR.md), [PER-CISO](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [PER-PRIV](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [PER-RE](../../personas/PER-RE.md), [PER-IO](../../personas/PER-IO.md), [PER-ISSE](../../personas/PER-ISSE.md), [PER-ISSM](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md) |

Purpose: Take initial remediation actions on deficient controls and have the assessor reassess them.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** A-4 is done (ART-SAR lists A-4 in `touched_by`). Why: remediation
   responds to the delivered report (SP 800-37r2 Task A-5).
2. **Read the inputs** in `## Inputs`. List every finding with `status: open` from
   `artifacts/sar/results/*.yaml`, with its control, severity and recommendation. Update
   ART-RA first if the findings call for it: the updated risk assessment and any input from
   the risk executive set the initial actions and their order.
3. **Interview** PER-PM (accountable) and PER-DEV for each open finding: was it fixed
   during the assessment period, how, when, and with what evidence (a new scan, a
   configuration change, a procedure now in force)? Ask PER-CCP about findings on an
   inherited part. Only quick fixes with existing resources belong here; everything else
   goes to the POA&M at A-6. Why: A-5 covers initial remediation that can be done quickly
   with existing resources (SP 800-37r2 Task A-5 discussion).
4. **Reassess each remediated finding** as PER-SCA (`personas/PER-SCA.md`): examine the new
   evidence, and interview or test as the SAP's methods for that control require (ART-SAP).
   Record the reassessment in a separate interview with `task: A-5` when an interview is the
   method. A finding is closed only when the evidence shows the control now meets the
   assessment objective; a claimed fix without evidence stays open. Why: the assessor
   reassesses remediated controls; the system owner's statement is not evidence.
5. **Update the family results** (`artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml`), each changed file
   whole:
   - a reassessed finding that passed: `status: closed`; keep its `title`, `description`
     and `severity` exactly as A-3 wrote them, and add the reassessment evidence to its
     `sources`;
   - its determination: when all its findings are closed, set `result: satisfied`, keep
     `finding_refs`, and prepend to the `summary`
     `Other-than-satisfied at A-3 (FND-###); reassessed at A-5: <evidence>.`;
   - a finding that failed reassessment stays `open`; append the reassessment result to its
     `description` as a sentence starting `A-5 reassessment:`.
   Why: the assessors update the report with the reassessment but do not change the
   original results (SP 800-37r2 Task A-5); the records keep both.
   Record `triage` on every finding (ASMT-006): `action`, `decided_by`, `significance`,
   `risk_basis` naming ART-RA, `rationale`. The actions are `immediate-remediation` (the AO's
   call), `remediated` (closed here), `poam`, `inconsequential` (the system owner's or CCP's
   call, not on a high finding; it stays in the report, is monitored at M-2 and needs no POA&M
   item) and `false-positive` (closed). Why: only substantive items go to the POA&M.
6. **Update the SSP statements** of the remediated controls
   (`artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml`, whole): the `statement` and `status` describe the
   control as it is now implemented, traced to the remediation answers. Change only the
   controls A-5 remediated. Why: the plans are updated to reflect implementation changes
   made in remediation (DoDI 8510.01 Table 5, A-5 outcome).
7. **Update the Markdown.**
   - `artifacts/ART-SAR.md`: append `A-5` to `touched_by` and add
     `## Remediation and reassessment (A-5)`: per remediated finding, the original result,
     the action taken, the reassessment evidence and the new status; then the findings that
     remain open for A-6. This is the addendum SP 800-37r2 Task A-5 describes, so the
     system owner's response may be quoted here, traced.
   - `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`: append `A-5` to `touched_by` and add a
     `## Changes from remediation (A-5)` section naming the controls whose statements
     changed and why.
8. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-5`,
   until 0 errors. A closed finding no longer needs a POA&M item (SAR-POAM-001).
9. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-PM | responsible and accountable (R, A) | which findings were fixed with existing resources, when, and the evidence |
| PER-DEV | responsible (R) | the technical change made for each fix, the new scan or test result |
| PER-CCP (when a finding falls on an inherited part) | responsible (R) | the provider's fix and its evidence |
| PER-ISSM (optional) | consulted (C) | procedural fixes now in force, records that show it |

At least 1 interview with `task: A-5`. PER-SCA (also responsible) is the role the agent
takes for the reassessment in step 4; the SCA is not a respondent.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-SAR.md`, `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` (only the families with a
  remediated finding)
- `artifacts/ART-SAP.md`, `artifacts/data/sap.yaml` (assessment methods for the
  reassessment)
- Assessment objectives: `uv run rmf catalog show --control <id> --fields objectives`

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` | — | changed families only, each written whole |
| `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` | — | changed families only, each written whole |
| `artifacts/ART-SAR.md` | `touched_by: [A-3, A-4, A-5]` | updated (updater) |
| `artifacts/ART-SSP.md` | append `A-5` to `touched_by` | updated (updater) |

## Facts

A-5 writes no facts.

## Done when

- Every finding fixed during the assessment is reassessed: closed with evidence, or still
  open with the reassessment result in its description.
- The SSP statements of the remediated controls describe the current implementation.
- ART-SAR and ART-SSP list A-5 in `touched_by`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-5` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task A-5`, with the findings closed and the
  findings left open.
- When remediation shows that the implementation recorded at I-2 was wrong beyond the
  fixed controls, journal a NOTE: A-5 feeds back to I-2, which owns the as-implemented
  update.
- A finding nobody fixed is no failure of A-5: it goes to A-6.
